proposal.reason: Primary change is in NET transport/proxy behavior: send-credit TX heads now default to sender-local device memory with new mapping/open/close and connect/free handling in src/transport/net.cc. It also introduces a distinct transport-level allocation-only P2P proxy buffer path (setup/connect/free API and ownership flow) in src/transport/p2p.cc and shared proxy/p2p interfaces. Additionally, allocator semantics are extended with MEM_LEGACY and corresponding free/untrack behavior in src/include/alloc.h, which is a substantive memory-ownership/lifecycle change supporting this feature.
